sloka: रुद्रो वा यदि वा विष्णुर्महेन्द्रो वा शतक्रतुः।हन्ति नो रामरूपेण यदि वा स्वयमन्तकः ।। ६.९५.२४ ।।
transliteration: rudro vā yadi vā viṣṇurmahendro vā śatakratuḥ।hanti no rāmarūpeṇa yadi vā svayamantakaḥ ।। 6.95.24 ।।

translations.english: "Horses, elephants, warriors, even foot soldiers were killed, chariots were destroyed, and hundreds and thousands struck down in war by Rama."
